title: Randomized time
statement: For a time bound $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the class $\mathrm{RTIME}(T)$ consists of all languages over the Boolean alphabet for which there are a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ and a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine that recognizes the language with one-sided error in time at most $cT(n)$ on inputs of length $n$.
